newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Session produces scant trading.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Session produces scant trading.

text.p: The first after-hours session of the week witnessed scant trading, leaving dealers little to report on Monday.
"It hasn't been a particularly active session," said one of them. "Nothing is trading out of line from their closing price."
A second dealer reported one or two trades in U.S. Long Distance Corp at the same price at which it closed on the Nasdaq.
U.S. Long Distance was down 3/16 at 15-5/16.
The company earlier said it expected to post a third-quarter charge related compensation to be paid Parris Holmes, who resigned as chairman.
The New York Stock Exchange on Monday said Session No.1 produced volume of 12,600 shares against 97,900 on Friday. In Session No.2, about 481,500 changed hands against 3.6 million.
